decision: Deprioritize a generic certified-payroll report generator. Permit further desk research only around a defined payroll-stack/destination exception; no opportunity or product launch is authorized.
rationale: Three vendors advertise reporting workflows, while this session did not establish independent residual small-contractor pain. A single Desktop-only vendor boundary does not demonstrate an unmet QBO market. This decision narrows research scope; it does not reject the existence of the reporting obligation.
alternatives: Continue broad form-generation exploration: rejected as low information gain given advertised substitutes.
Declare the entire reporting problem solved: rejected because vendor claims were not tested and exception evidence is missing.
Narrow to a specific integration pair and seek disconfirming customer evidence: preferred only if useful evidence can be obtained.
decision_maker: Codex issue-6 research prioritization; not founder commercial authorization.
revisit_conditions: Independent dated evidence of recurring manual exception work after correct incumbent setup.
Current official source/destination schemas reveal a specific transformation not served by existing tools.
A platform or destination requirement changes and invalidates an incumbent path.
title: Pause generic certified-payroll generation exploration; require a specific interoperability gap

history.reason: Issue #6 public-documentation comparison; no product testing, customer interviews or market validation.
